```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(tabulapdf)
library(DT)

neuro2_available <- requireNamespace("neuro2", quietly = TRUE)
if (neuro2_available) library(neuro2)

options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 50 * 1024^2)

# Conners-4 specific scale definitions
conners4_scales <- list(
  content = c(
    "Inattention/Executive Dysfunction",
    "Hyperactivity", 
    "Impulsivity",
    "Emotional Dysregulation",
    "Depressed Mood",
    "Anxious Thoughts"
  ),
  impairment = c(
    "Schoolwork",
    "Peer Interactions", 
    "Family Life"
  ),
  dsm = c(
    "ADHD Inattentive Symptoms",
    "ADHD Hyperactive/Impulsive Symptoms",
    "Total ADHD Symptoms",
    "Oppositional Defiant Disorder Symptoms",
    "Conduct Disorder Symptoms"
  ),
  index = c("ADHD Index")
)

# Lookup table (fallback)
lookup_path <- "~/Dropbox/neuropsych_lookup_table.csv"
if (file.exists(lookup_path)) {
  lookup_table <- read.csv(lookup_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("conners4", test, ignore.case = TRUE))
} else {
  lookup_table <- data.frame(test = character(), scale = character())
}
```

## Conners-4 Extractor

Extract score tables from Conners-4 Self, Parent, or Teacher PDF reports.

---

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar

selectInput(
  "rater",
  "Rater Type",
  choices = c(
    "Self-Report" = "conners4_self",
    "Parent" = "conners4_parent", 
    "Teacher" = "conners4_teacher"
  ),
  selected = "conners4_self"
)

hr()

fileInput("file", "Upload Conners-4 PDF", accept = ".pdf")

numericInput("pages", "Page(s) to Extract", value = 2, min = 1, max = 20)

selectInput(
  "scale_type",
  "Scale Type",
  choices = c(
    "Content Scales" = "content",
    "Impairment Scales" = "impairment",
    "DSM Symptom Scales" = "dsm",
    "ADHD Index" = "index",
    "All (auto-detect)" = "all"
  ),
  selected = "all"
)

hr()

uiOutput("table_selector")

hr()

actionButton("extract", "Extract Tables", class = "btn-success")
downloadButton("download", "Download CSV", class = "btn-primary")
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill

verbatimTextOutput("status")

hr()

uiOutput("column_mapper")

hr()

h4("Processed Scores")
DTOutput("results")

hr()

details(
  summary = "Raw Extraction (Debug)",
  DTOutput("raw")
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server

safe_num <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", as.character(x))))
}

# Extract tables
raw_tables <- eventReactive(input$extract, {
  req(input$file)
  withProgress(message = "Extracting...", {
    tryCatch({
      tabulapdf::extract_tables(
        file = input$file$datapath,
        pages = input$pages,
        method = "stream",
        output = "matrix"
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(e$message, type = "error")
      NULL
    })
  })
})

# Table selector
output$table_selector <- renderUI({
  req(raw_tables())
  n <- length(raw_tables())
  if (n > 1) {
    selectInput("table_idx", paste0("Table (", n, " found)"),
                choices = seq_len(n), selected = 1)
  }
})

table_idx <- reactive({
  if (!is.null(input$table_idx)) as.integer(input$table_idx) else 1
})

# Candidate table
candidate <- reactive({
  req(raw_tables())
  df <- as.data.frame(raw_tables()[[table_idx()]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df[] <- lapply(df, trimws)
  colnames(df) <- paste0("V", seq_len(ncol(df)))
  df
})

# Column mapping UI
output$column_mapper <- renderUI({
  req(candidate())
  df <- candidate()
  cols <- colnames(df)
  
  choices <- setNames(cols, sapply(cols, function(c) {
    paste0(c, " (", paste(head(df[[c]], 2), collapse = ", "), ")")
  }))
  none <- c("None" = "None")
  
  wellPanel(
    h5("Column Mapping (T-Score Layout)"),
    fluidRow(
      column(4, selectInput("col_scale", "Scale Name:", choices = choices, selected = cols[1])),
      column(4, selectInput("col_raw", "Raw Score:", choices = c(none, choices), 
                            selected = if (length(cols) >= 2) cols[2] else "None")),
      column(4, selectInput("col_score", "T-Score:", choices = choices,
                            selected = if (length(cols) >= 3) cols[3] else cols[1]))
    ),
    fluidRow(
      column(4, selectInput("col_ci", "CI:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
      column(4, selectInput("col_percentile", "Percentile:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
      column(4, selectInput("col_range", "Range:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None"))
    ),
    fluidRow(
      column(4, selectInput("col_prob", "Probability %:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
      column(4, selectInput("col_guideline", "Guideline:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None"))
    )
  )
})

# Process data
processed <- reactive({
  req(candidate(), input$col_scale, input$col_score)
  
  df <- candidate()
  
  result <- data.frame(
    scale = trimws(df[[input$col_scale]]),
    score = safe_num(df[[input$col_score]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Optional columns
  if (input$col_raw != "None") result$raw_score <- safe_num(df[[input$col_raw]])
  if (input$col_ci != "None") result$ci_95 <- gsub("–|—", "-", trimws(df[[input$col_ci]]))
  if (input$col_percentile != "None") result$percentile <- safe_num(df[[input$col_percentile]])
  if (input$col_range != "None") result$range <- trimws(df[[input$col_range]])
  if (input$col_prob != "None") result$probability_score <- trimws(df[[input$col_prob]])
  if (input$col_guideline != "None") result$guideline <- trimws(df[[input$col_guideline]])
  
  # Filter valid
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(scale), scale != "", !is.na(score) | scale == "ADHD Index")
  
  # Identify scale type
  all_scales <- unlist(conners4_scales)
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      scale_category = dplyr::case_when(
        scale %in% conners4_scales$content ~ "Content",
        scale %in% conners4_scales$impairment ~ "Impairment",
        scale %in% conners4_scales$dsm ~ "DSM",
        scale %in% conners4_scales$index ~ "Index",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )
  
  # Filter by selected scale type
  if (input$scale_type != "all") {
    target_scales <- conners4_scales[[input$scale_type]]
    result <- result |> dplyr::filter(scale %in% target_scales)
  }
  
  # Add metadata
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      test = input$rater,
      test_name = dplyr::case_when(
        input$rater == "conners4_self" ~ "Conners-4 Self",
        input$rater == "conners4_parent" ~ "Conners-4 Parent",
        input$rater == "conners4_teacher" ~ "Conners-4 Teacher"
      ),
      domain = "ADHD",
      test_type = "rating_scale",
      score_type = "t_score"
    )
  
  # Join with lookup
  if (nrow(lookup_table) > 0) {
    lookup_cols <- lookup_table |>
      dplyr::filter(test == input$rater) |>
      dplyr::select(scale, subdomain, narrow, absort, description) |>
      dplyr::distinct()
    
    if (nrow(lookup_cols) > 0) {
      result <- result |>
        dplyr::left_join(lookup_cols, by = "scale")
    }
  }
  
  # Apply neuro2 ranges
  if (neuro2_available && exists("gpluck_make_score_ranges", where = asNamespace("neuro2"))) {
    result <- result |>
      dplyr::mutate(result = NA_character_) |>
      neuro2::gpluck_make_score_ranges(test_type = "rating_scale")
  }
  
  result
})

# Outputs
output$status <- renderText({
  if (is.null(raw_tables())) return("Upload PDF and click Extract")
  paste0("✓ ", length(raw_tables()), " table(s) | ", nrow(processed()), " scales")
})

output$raw <- renderDT({
  req(candidate())
  datatable(candidate(), options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 5))
})

output$results <- renderDT({
  req(processed())
  datatable(processed(), options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 15))
})

output$download <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() paste0(input$rater, "_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
  content = function(file) write.csv(processed(), file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
)
```
